snippet.title: Where Winds Meet - Hidden Mountain: Main Chapter Finale Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Where Winds Meet is a wuxia action-adventure role-playing game by Everstone Studio and Netease set in the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Where Winds Meet comes to Xbox Series X/S, PC, Cloud, and Game Pass in September.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
